# Anatomy, Bony Pelvis and Lower Limb: Thigh Muscles

**Authors:** Basem Attum, Matthew A. Varacallo

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

The thigh region is essential to the proper postural stability and locomotion of humans and is also a key conduit for neurovascular structures that pass from the abdomen to the lower limbs (see Image. Cross-Section of the Thigh). The thigh muscles are divided into groups based on location – the anterior, medial, and posterior compartments - each affording the lower limb different functional movements. Understanding the main function of each group of muscles and the unique properties of muscles within a group helps identify different disorders based on the physical examination and patient history.
